name: Giles
cooked:
My Tensorfold v1.1.x repo is starting to become competitive with the v0.6.6 (python based) repo.

Initial Load time is still very slow, and prefill is lacking. Decode is superior at c1, c2, but has been lacking at c4.

Currently GLM 5.3 Flash is re-quantizing the model, which is going to take some hours.

NB GLM 5.3 Flash is making all the decisions here, and is continuing to fold in commits from upstream.
